description: Least-privilege capability for the main window: core app/window basics, explicit native security commands, SQL access to the single local application database, HTTP access scoped to the Tenders-SA application API path plus the two document-serving origins used by tender downloads (Slice 7), save and directory dialogs, and filesystem/path-opener access restricted to $TEMP/tenders-sa/** (Slice 8). No shell, URL-opening, or broad filesystem access is granted. The http allow-list is a security boundary, not configuration: it bounds the set of origins the runtime API base URL may point at and the origins that may serve document bytes, and src/tests/capability-scope.test.ts fails if it is widened. The API entry is exactly one -- the production application API -- because the application origin is hard-wired to https://www.tenders-sa.org and is never configurable. The two document entries are scoped to the exact serving paths the parent's download-url route resolves to (https://docs.tenders-sa.org/docs/* and https://etenders-api.tenders-sa.org/api/document*); they carry no API key. Save dialogs extend the fs scope at runtime to the user-picked export/document path; Open writes only a temporary copy beneath $TEMP/tenders-sa and opens only that scoped path.
